ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
previous=json.loads((ROOT.parent/'lab4-prepared/manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
prior={entry['path']:entry for entry in previous['files']}
release_path=ROOT/'previous-release-manifest.json'
release={entry['path']:entry for entry in json.loads(release_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['files']} if release_path.exists() else {}
files=[]
for folder in ('common','lab6_gomoku'):
    for path in sorted((ROOT/folder).glob('*')):
        if not path.is_file():continue
        relative=path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        old=prior.get(relative)
        if folder=='common':
            assert old,relative
            if relative!='common/touch.c':assert sha(path)==old['sha256'],relative
        allowed=list(old['allowedPreviousSHA256']) if old else []
        if relative in release:allowed.extend([release[relative]['sha256'],*release[relative]['allowedPreviousSHA256']])
        files.append({'path':relative,'sha256':sha(path),'allowedPreviousSHA256':sorted(set(allowed))})
for name in ('test_game.c','test_storage.c','test_touch_start.c'):
    relative='tests/'+name;old=release.get(relative)
    allowed=sorted(set([old['sha256'],*old['allowedPreviousSHA256']])) if old else []
    files.append({'path':relative,'sha256':sha(ROOT/relative),'allowedPreviousSHA256':allowed})
manifest={'version':'2026-10-18-gomoku-v3-audit','courseHeaderSHA256':sha(ROOT/'common/common.h'),
          'files':files,'hardwareValidated':False,'target':'Orange Pi 4 LTS, Linux aarch64',
